1	\begin{abstract}
2	Large language models increasingly replace human annotators in computational social science, yet their error rates can vary by up to $5\times$ across demographic and text-feature subgroups.
3	When these noisy labels serve as effect modifiers in heterogeneous treatment effect (HTE) analysis, the standard remedy, estimating a single confusion matrix and applying its inverse uniformly, is widely trusted to remove bias.
4	We prove it can do the opposite.
5	We derive an exact bias identity showing that global correction introduces a subgroup-level bias proportional to the interaction of error-rate deviation and effect heterogeneity, a product structure invisible to any pooled analysis.
6	This identity reveals that correction reverses estimated causal effect signs in 14.9\% of configurations and amplifies bias across all eight real LLMs tested.
7	A diagnostic corollary flags harmful correction from error rates alone, without estimating treatment effects.
8	Guided by the identity, we propose EC-HTE, a per-subgroup correction via hierarchical Bayesian confusion matrix estimation that reduces bias by $7.4\times$ under extreme heterogeneity, with clear operating conditions ($\Delta\pi > 0.15$, $n_{\text{expert}} \geq 250$, $K \leq 4$) and validated across 11 LLM--dataset combinations spanning four NLP tasks\footnote{Code and data: \url{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ec_hte_llm_annotation-4CC8/}.}.
9	\end{abstract}

通读了摘要和引言，摘要没问题，引言第三、四段有叙事节奏问题：

**段3（line 20）只有一句话**，但塞了三个独立 claim：14.9% sign reversal + 全部 8 个 LLM 放大 bias + EC-HTE 消除 sign reversal。一句话里用分号串联了"问题有多严重""我们的方法有多好"，读者来不及消化。而且从段2（机制解释）到段3（定量结果）之间没有过渡，直接甩数字。

**段4（lines 22-23）两句话做了两件完全不同的事**：第一句是理论贡献（bias identity, R²≥0.97, 7.4×），第二句是文献定位（现有方法都假设同质误差）。这两句之间缺少逻辑连接——为什么需要一个精确的 bias identity？因为段3的经验观察需要理论解释，但这个"为什么"从未说出。

**整体节奏问题**：段1-2 花了较多篇幅铺背景和机制（合理），但段3-4 突然加速，用 3 句话试图完成"量化问题 + 理论贡献 + 文献 gap + 方法介绍"四件事。读者的体感是前慢后赶。

**建议**：把段3和段4合并重组为一个节奏更均匀的段落——先从段2的机制过渡到定量（"We quantify this effect..."），给出 14.9% 数据，然后自然引出 bias identity 作为理论解释，再点出 existing methods 的 gap，最后一句引出 EC-HTE。这样"问题→量化→理论→gap→方案"一气呵成。

[飞书用户 曹晓玉]: 🔍 匿名化最后扫雷：日期 + 内部编号

发现有些论文里残留了**具体实验日期**和**内部编号**——这两种东西是 reviewer 一查就能反向定位作者 / 团队的硬证据，必须彻底清掉。

══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
1. 必须删 / 改：具体日期
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

任何能锁到一周内的时间点都不允许出现。包括但不限于：

❌ "Experiments were conducted on May 18, 2026..."
❌ "We collected data between 2026-04-10 and 2026-04-25..."
❌ "Models were trained on 2026/05/15..."
❌ "Snapshot from 2026-Q1..."
❌ "as of October 2025"
❌ "the recent release of GPT-5 on July 22..."

替换为相对 / 模糊表述：

✅ "Experiments were conducted in recent months."
✅ "Data was collected over a two-week period."
✅ "Models were trained for X GPU-hours."

唯一例外：引用别人论文 / 数据集发布时间（"Llama-3 (Meta, 2024)" 这种是 citation，不算）。

══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
2. 必须删 / 改：内部编号
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

任何内部追溯编号都不允许出现：

❌ Experiment ID: "exp_2026_0518_a3" / "run_42_v7"
❌ WandB run ID / wandb.ai 链接
❌ 项目内部 codename（如 cost-verify-agent-rl 这种）
❌ Git commit hash
❌ Internal ticket / Jira ID
❌ Server hostname / GPU node 名（"trained on cqa1-33015"）
❌ 内部文件夹路径（"/home/USER/exp_logs/..."）
❌ Orchestration 工具名（Ralph / Director / Manager / Agent 等）

══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
3. 容易漏检的位置
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

不只检查正文。下列位置最容易残留：

- Figure / Table caption
- Appendix 里的 log snippet / yaml dump / shell output
- Hyperparameter 表
- \texttt{} / \verb{} 代码块
- .tex 注释（% 后面的内容）
- .bib 文件里相关字段
- PDF 元数据

══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
汇报内容
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

(a) 各类命中位置数量：日期 X 处，内部编号 Y 处
(b) 每一处的处理方式（改成什么 / 删了什么）
(c) 修完后确认 0 残留

Full-width academic concept figure for a top-venue NLP paper (EMNLP). Single figure, aspect ratio ~2.8:1, figsize (14, 5) inches. This is a left-right pipeline comparison showing two approaches to correcting LLM annotation errors for causal inference.

OVERALL LAYOUT:
- Two side-by-side vertical pipelines separated by a thin vertical dashed gray line (#CCCCCC, linewidth 0.5) at 50% width
- Left pipeline: "Standard Correction" — muted rose/warm palette
- Right pipeline: "EC-HTE (Ours)" — muted teal/cool palette
- A subtle large "VS" or vertical divider between them
- Both pipelines flow top-to-bottom with the same number of stages for visual symmetry

LEFT PIPELINE — "Standard Correction" (rose palette):
Title at top: "Standard Correction" in 11pt bold serif, color #8B4553

Stage 1 (top): Shared input row
- Rounded rectangle box (corner radius 8px), fill #FFF5F5, border #D4A0A0, border width 1.2pt
- Label: "LLM Labels Ẑ" in 10pt serif
- Small subtitle below: "error rates vary across subgroups" in 8pt italic gray (#888888)

Stage 2: Arrow down (thin, elegant, color #C4A0A0)
- Rounded rectangle, fill #F9E4E4, border #D4A0A0
- Label: "Pooled Confusion Matrix" in 10pt serif
- Small icon or visual: a single small matrix grid (2x2 or 3x3) drawn with thin lines
- Subtitle: "one C̄ for all subgroups" in 8pt gray

Stage 3: Arrow down
- Rounded rectangle, fill #F9E4E4, border #D4A0A0
- Label: "Uniform Inversion" in 10pt serif
- Visual: three small identical squares in a row (representing subgroups) all getting the same correction, connected by a single bracket from above
- Subtitle: "C̄⁻¹ applied identically" in 8pt gray

Stage 4 (bottom): Result box
- Rounded rectangle, fill #FFE8E8, border #C0392B, border width 1.5pt
- Small warning triangle icon (⚠) in #C0392B
- Label: "Bias amplification" in 10pt serif bold #C0392B
- Subtitle: "over-corrects low-error, under-corrects high-error subgroups" in 8pt #8B4553

RIGHT PIPELINE — "EC-HTE (Ours)" (teal palette):
Title at top: "EC-HTE (Ours)" in 11pt bold serif, color #1A6B6B

Stage 1 (top): Shared input row (visually aligned with left)
- Rounded rectangle, fill #F0FAFA, border #7FB8B8, border width 1.2pt
- Label: "LLM Labels Ẑ + Expert Sample" in 10pt serif
- Subtitle: "stratified validation labels" in 8pt italic gray

Stage 2: Arrow down (thin, elegant, color #7FB8B8)
- Rounded rectangle, fill #E0F0F0, border #7FB8B8
- Label: "Hierarchical Bayes" in 10pt serif
- Visual: multiple small matrix grids (3 tiny matrices side by side) representing per-subgroup estimation
- Subtitle: "per-subgroup Ĉₛ with partial pooling" in 8pt gray

Stage 3: Arrow down
- Rounded rectangle, fill #E0F0F0, border #7FB8B8
- Label: "Stratified Inversion + κ-guard" in 10pt serif
- Visual: three small squares of DIFFERENT sizes or shades (representing different corrections per subgroup)
- Subtitle: "Ĉₛ⁻¹ tailored to each subgroup" in 8pt gray

Stage 4 (bottom): Result box
- Rounded rectangle, fill #E0FAF0, border #27AE60, border width 1.5pt
- Small checkmark icon (✓) in #27AE60
- Label: "Corrected CATE + CI" in 10pt serif bold #1A6B6B
- Subtitle: "bias reduced, uncertainty propagated" in 8pt #1A6B6B

CONNECTING ELEMENTS:
- Between left Stage 1 and right Stage 1: a subtle horizontal dashed arrow or shared boundary indicating they start from the same data
- The vertical divider line runs the full height, subtle and elegant
- Small label at very top center: nothing (let the two titles speak)

STYLE REQUIREMENTS:
- Publication quality for a TOP venue (EMNLP 2026)
- Elegant, premium, sophisticated — NOT cheap or homework-like
- Subtle drop shadows (2px offset, 8% opacity, color #00000014) on ALL boxes
- Rounded corners (10px) on all rectangles
- Thin, elegant arrow heads — not bulky matplotlib defaults. Use FancyArrowPatch with arrowstyle='->', mutation_scale=12
- Serif font (Times New Roman / DejaVu Serif) for all labels
- Muted, harmonious color palette — rose vs teal, NO saturated primary colors
- Generous white space between stages (vertical gap ~0.8 inches)
- Consistent visual weight across both pipelines
- NO matplotlib default styling: no gray background, no thick gridlines, no tab10 colors
- White (#FFFFFF) background
- 300 DPI
- All text must be readable when figure is scaled to full textwidth (~6.5 inches) in a two-column paper
- Minimum font size when rendered: 7pt

ANTI-PATTERNS TO AVOID:
- No data numbers, percentages, or quantitative results on the figure
- No dense equations — keep it conceptual
- No more than 4 stages per pipeline
- No clipart or emoji — use simple geometric shapes for visual cues
- No gradients — use flat muted fills
- The warning triangle and checkmark should be simple unicode or drawn shapes, not emoji
